Defect.title: Defect
Defect.description: Represents a single software defect reported in the system, detailing its characteristics, status, and assignment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Defect entity.

summary.description: A concise title or summary of the defect.

description.description: A detailed explanation of the defect, including steps to reproduce and expected vs. actual results.

domain.description: The functional or technical domain/module to which the defect belongs.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the defect (e.g., To-Do, In Progress, Ready for Testing, Closed, Reopened).

severity.description: The impact level of the defect on the system or user (e.g., Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial).

priority.description: The urgency with which the defect needs to be addressed and resolved (e.g., High, Medium, Low).

created_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the defect was initially created.

updated.description: The timestamp indicating when the defect was last updated.

reported_by.description: The name or identifier of the user who reported this defect.

UsageEvent.title: UsageEvent
UsageEvent.description: Logs of user interactions and system events for auditing and analytics.

AppConfiguration.title: AppConfiguration
AppConfiguration.description: Global application settings including API keys and external links.

SavedPrediction.title: SavedPrediction
SavedPrediction.description: An expert-validated defect prediction example used for AI training.

/users/{userId}/defects/{defectId}.description: Subcollection containing Defect documents uploaded by a specific user.

/usageEvents/{eventId}.description: A flat collection of usage logs for administrative oversight.

/appConfiguration/global.description: Singleton document for global app settings.

/sharedFeedback/{feedbackId}.description: Collection of expert feedback examples for AI few-shot learning.
